description:
Two files define UUID namespace constants in nearly the same shape:

- emit.rs:88-93: NS_REPORT / NS_RESULT / NS_OBSERVATION / NS_FINDING / NS_RISK / NS_RISK_POLICY
- catalog.rs:81-83: NS_CATALOG / NS_CONTROL / NS_PARAM

Each is local to the file with no central registry. A future contributor adding a new OSCAL object kind would need to grep two files to verify their new salt doesn't collide.

Suggested rewrite: a single pkix-lint/src/oscal/namespaces.rs (or a const block in oscal/mod.rs) collecting all namespace strings, with rustdoc explaining the collision invariant ('two object kinds derived from the same seed bytes must use distinct namespaces').

Minor readability — the current setup works, but the implicit cross-file invariant is the kind of thing that quietly breaks during refactors.
title: OSCAL emitter and Catalog emitter use parallel-but-separate uuid_v8 namespace constants
